title: Audit phase-order bank sharing and repair historical CI replays
body:
For PR2850's producer-first phase-accumulator schedule, returning the bank does not by itself certify the desired data phase. This independent audit gives the exact consumer-order/cross-term criterion and a sharp minimum active-bank-bit count in the explicitly restricted one-assigned-tensor-bit-per-column model. For example, reversed consumers can share one bank bit, while identical producer/consumer order requires separate bits.

The written all-size argument shows that legal bank classes are decreasing subsequences of the consumer permutation. Its longest increasing subsequence is both a lower witness and the number of bits used by the constructive rank assignment. This applies the standard permutation-order partition argument to the predecessor's Pauli boundary; it is not a general bank-dimension theorem or a new combinatorial method.

The scientific result is isolated in `research/phase-order-bank-audit/`. The later CI maintenance commits described below address concrete inherited failures blocking this PR. Base canonical main is `4865c30d0fb12a475bb6eaaca1c781a1592a3811`, priority revision 5; the pre-submission refresh to `d311a18c6061af67d0aa35cbeced605b8b7472ed` left the relevant guidance and selected record unchanged. Exact contribution head: `395b7fbde8f009263c8dceb46e0f2ee8a2a6e846`.

Validation on native Windows CPython 3.12.14:

- Registered replay passes under `-I -O -B`.
- All 5,913 consumer permutations for f<=7; every set partition for f<=5 (6,635 schedule/partition cases), with 153 independently minimized permutations.
- A separate Fraction-valued physical-array implementation checks all 488 joint input columns / 87,104 coefficients in five f<=3 fixtures, including arbitrary bank lanes.
- Ten semantic controls plus relocated Git-free/read-only replay and result/reference-pin corruption rejection.
- 97 repository research-helper tests pass, with 7 platform-specific skips.
- Exact committed-byte preflight and staged whitespace checks pass; working tree is clean.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/phase-order-bank-audit
```

Limitations: the literal unfused schedule retains 4f one-axis C calls before wrappers. This is a count for that schedule, not an implementation lower bound. No encoded/general bank optimum, native invoice recertification, two-parent-level C/Q replay, physical caller admission, selected cold replay, new supplier or kappa improvement is claimed. Predecessor source files are inspected references pinned by commit/blob/SHA-256; they are not imported or reauthenticated remotely by the standalone replay. The two arithmetic implementations belong to this same AI-assisted audit author, with no independent human review or proof assistant.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2842#discussioncomment-18964255. This takes the released independent-audit handoff. Complete overlap coverage: 543 open PRs, 2,014 closed/merged PRs and 1,502 Discussion records at the recorded UTC snapshots; not a novelty guarantee.

Credit Gareth Davidson / bitplane's PR2850 at `a007c32f992195ad372806db38c9359dd49382ad` for the exact accumulator contract, original counterexample, working reverse/tensor controls and paid-recursion handoff. Earlier contributor credit remains in the unchanged predecessor. New work by Dennis / antunishdPursuit, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, source inspection, implementation, execution, self-review and writing. Apache-2.0. No selected frontier or frozen predecessor is changed.

CI maintenance (scientific package remains unchanged at `395b7fbd`):

- Restore authenticated historical scheduler/HPE/graph helpers only in private replay copies. Keep frozen source manifests, archive bytes, all original Make/test commands, negative controls and final unchanged-file gates. Retain live reviewed optimization successors and their performance tests. The ledger uses its current records with original per-PR source contexts, including nested complete-inventory replays.
- Fetch the three exact Git baselines needed by existing shallow-checkout performance tests. Retain all checks rather than skipping missing-history failures.
- Correct the native workflow's literal-plus glob and Python 3.13+ symlink-cycle detection. The ledger regression follows every authoritative review round rather than stopping at efficient1200; forged-head and arbitrary-byte rejection controls remain.
- Refresh only `certificate_sha256` in the two stale joint/skip validation receipts after accepted production commit `73cc66d0`. A strict maintenance generator binds exact old/new bytes; all mathematical receipt fields and pinned mathematical generators stay unchanged. Full Linux regeneration and clean-tree checks are still required.

Maintenance attribution: retained source headers and original graph/audit authors; Wentao Li's preserved baselines and production optimizations; ywz65's UTF-8 successor; Aaron Wang's containment scan; Chafik Boukhalfa's verifier/certificates; existing assertion/scheduler contributors. Adapter and regression changes by Dennis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. Maintenance commits are independently reviewable in branch history.

Verified locally: full current ledger audit of 2,356 PR records, its nested historical tree audits and final unchanged-file gate; 26 historical-replay tests, 38 reconciliation tests (normal and optimized parents), 13 isolated-runner tests, three exact receipt-rebinding controls; official actionlint v1.7.12. Windows symlink controls are skipped when symlink creation is unavailable; Linux must exercise them. No full selected cold replay is claimed.

Current repair head: `9b173438a7d74570111bf4b51ac34a4afa56b4cc`. Fresh exact-head Linux runs: [main matrix](https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38854161141), [exact tooling/ledger](https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38854160606), [reconciliation92](https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38854160644); in progress, not reported as passes. Earlier head `5d6e8218` already passed reconciliation92 and the exact-accelerator/rejection-control step. Canonical PR checks remain queued; current main refresh `4cc9d09a124e06dd358fdc1c3d4b2af51dd44649` leaves relevant guidance/priorities/selected record and affected implementation inputs unchanged. Fork registered-package dispatch remains unavailable because its stale default branch does not register that newer workflow; no default-branch changes were made.

CI coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2732#discussioncomment-18964462. The broader affected-input CI architecture in PR2361 is separate and not duplicated here.
